description: Read capability themes (KSIs): list themes, one theme, the multi-axis scorecard, per-theme evidence posture, or the controls mapped to a theme. Pick with method.

limit.description: Max results per page (1–200, default 50) Used by: controls.

method.description:
list: List an organization's 11 KSI capability themes. Themes group NIST 800-53 controls into security capability areas for a high-level posture view.
get: Get a single capability theme (KSI) with full posture, multi-axis scores, band, and legacy posture_percentage.
scorecard: Get the multi-axis KSI scorecard for every capability theme. Returns per-theme Implementation Coverage, Maturity, Evidence Coverage, Evidence Quality, and composite KSI Posture Score bands.
evidence_posture: Get per-theme evidence metrics: controls with evidence, file counts by assessment status, average relevance score, and derived confidence (strong/moderate/weak/none). Use for KSI evidence dashboards.
controls: List SCF controls mapped to a capability theme (KSI), with scoping status, implementation status, and maturity level. Supports pagination and scope filtering — ideal for KSI drill-down.

offset.description: Pagination offset — number of results to skip (default 0) Used by: controls.

scope_status.description: Filter by scoping status (default: in_scope) Used by: controls.

theme_code.description: Capability theme code (e.g., 'ACCESS_CONTROL', 'INCIDENT_RESPONSE') — obtain from scf_list_capability_themes [get] | Capability theme code (e.g., 'ACCESS_CONTROL') — obtain from scf_list_capability_themes [controls] Used by: get, controls.

name: scf_capability_theme_read
